claim: Senigallia's seafront is 13 km of very fine golden sand, soft as velvet, giving it the name Spiaggia di Velluto; it holds Blue Flag certification continuously since 1997 and has over 60 lifeguard stations with shallow, current-free water ideal for families.
quote: thirteen kilometres of very fine golden sand, as soft and light as velvet

claim: The Spiaggia di Velluto nickname comes from the exceptionally fine, soft sand that feels like walking on velvet, a feature distinguishing it from other Adriatic beaches.
quote: the velvet beach of Senigallia owes its name to the very fine sand that resembles a soft velvet carpet between the city and the sea

claim: The Rotonda a Mare is an elegant rationalist-style seaside venue built in the 1930s by engineer Enrico Cardelli, with a covered platform and raised terrace; it peaked as a glamorous entertainment temple in the 1950s-60s, reopened in 2006 after a fire, and now hosts exhibitions and events free of charge June-September.
quote: typically rationalist... a platform with a large covered canopy and a large raised terrace, created by engineer Enrico Cardelli

claim: The Rotonda a Mare originated as a Belle Epoque wooden hydrotherapy platform; the decision to build it was made January 30 1932 and it was inaugurated July 18 1933, becoming the symbol of Senigallia.
quote: la decisione definitiva di costruire la Rotonda a Mare... fu inaugurata il 18 luglio 1933

claim: Senigallia's 13 km seafront mixes equipped beach clubs (stabilimenti / bagni) with free public beaches (spiaggia libera), spread across the Ponente (west) and Levante (east) sides on lungomari Mameli, Marconi, Da Vinci, Alighieri and Italia.
quote: Tutti gli stabilimenti balneari a Senigallia

claim: At a Senigallia stabilimento in 2026 an umbrella plus two loungers averages about 159 euros per week (Aug 2-8, first four rows), one of the more affordable Italian resorts with only a 0.6% increase over 2025.
quote: Senigallia... 159 euro per ombrellone e due lettini... aumento dello 0,6%

claim: You can cycle along nearly the entire 13 km of Senigallia coast on dedicated bike paths, including an 8 km route connecting the centre to Marzocca via the eastern waterfront, part of the Adriatic Cycle Route (Ciclovia Adriatica).
quote: percorrere in bicicletta quasi tutti i 13 km di costa su pista ciclabile

claim: Lungomare Goffredo Mameli is a vibrant seafront promenade stretching for kilometres, ideal for morning jogs or strolls, lined with beachwear shops, souvenir stalls and eateries.
quote: a vibrant seafront promenade that stretches for kilometers, offering an ideal setting for morning jogs or leisurely strolls
